common.title: Automated Decision Scandal
common.line: An AI-supported decision system in social insurance, policing or the courts is found to have systematically wronged people, with a judgment or an ombudsman finding behind it.

common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Open Weights Capability Jump
common.line: An open-weight release lands within a few months of the closed frontier.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Anti ai sabotage wave
notable.line: Coordinated physical attacks on data-centre construction sites and grid substations across several member states force extended construction halts and emergency security costs.

notable.title: Anti ai street wave
notable.line: Coordinated municipal utility strikes and graduate-led blockades of data-centre sites spread across several member states, linking job-loss protests to energy bills and ransomware outages.
